summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to prevent payments received from personal injury, physical sickness, or property damage settlements, including those from the East Palestine train derailment, from being counted as income or resources when determining eligibility for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act to exclude certain settlement payments from being counted as income or resources for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) beneficiaries. This prevents disaster victims from losing their SSI benefits due to receiving settlement money, effectively expanding the scope of who can receive or retain welfare benefits.
